newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves to banking system Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves to banking system Thurs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to add reserves to the banking system on Thursday either through overnight or multiple-day fixed-system repurchase agreements (RPs), economists said.

Two RPs run off the books this session while two others remain in effect, said Marc Wanshel, economist at Morgan Guaranty Trust Co. He added that a combination of quarter end, note settlement and end of maintenance period pressures should push federal funds well above target early next week and, accordingly, saw the Fed replacing $6 billion in maturing RPs with a larger (about $8 billion) seven-day fixed-system RP.
Federal funds were trading at 5-1/2 percent, right at the Fed's current official target level.
